Bldg. 15 & 16 PARTY WALL DECLARATION OF RESTRICTIONS,made as of this 15th day of July, 2002,by Landmark Projects IV, Inc., having offices at 250 Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10003 (hereinafter referred to as the “Developer") and NYC Partnership Housing Development Fund Company, Inc., having offices at One Battery Park Plaza, New York, New York 10004, (hereinafter referred to as the “NYCP") (Developer and NYCP are hereinafter collectively referred to as the“Declarants"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, NYCP is the owner of the real property located in the Borough of Manhattan as described on Schedule“A""(Block 1911 Lot 18and part of Lot 118 and Block 1911 Lot 19 and part of Lot 118), annexed hereto and made a part hereof, upon WHEREAS, the Developer has built two residential buildings in such a manner that each of the buildings shall adjoin the other and shall be connected to each other by a commonParty Wall ("Party Wall"); WHEREAS the Declarants desire to declare the following restrictions, covenants and agreements governing said Party Wall; and WHEREAS, the home designated as Block 1911 Lot 18 and part of Lot 118 is located at street address 133 West 126th Street, New York, N.Y. and the home on the other side of the Party Wall is designated as Block 1911, Lot 19 and part of Lot 118 is located at street address 129 West 126th Street, New York, NY; NOW THEREFORE,the following declaration of restrictions, covenants and agreements shall run with the land and be binding upon the Declarants herein, their heirs, successors and assigns and shall run with the land and be binding upon each successive owner of Block1911 Lot18and part of Lot118and ofBlock1911 Lot19 andpart of Lot 118, New York, N.Y. and the heirs, successors and assigns of each such subsequent owner. 1. ThePartyWall was constructed in such a fashion as to belocated an equal distance on or over the respective adjoining lots with the midline of the Party Wall being located as nearly as possible on the common boundary line and it is understood that minor variations may be present due to topographical problems or construction requirements. 2. ThePartyWall shall be used and maintained as a PartyWall forever and the owner of theloton eachsideof thePartyWall,shallbelicensed and permitted toenter upon the premises of the owner on the other side of the Party Wall to make necessary repairs upon advance notification to said adjoining owner of such intentions to do so.
